name: systematic-debugging
title_zh: 报错先别改代码，按这五步定位根因
tagline_zh: 测试红了、行为怪了、报错看不懂了——在提修复方案之前，它逼你把「症状」翻译成「机制」，用可复现实验锁定真凶。
tagline_en: Test red? Weird behavior? Before proposing a fix, it forces you to translate symptoms into mechanisms and pin the.
desc_en: Use when encountering any bug, test failure, or unexpected behavior, before proposing fixes
why_zh: 不是教你怎么修，而是先切断「看到报错就改代码」的反射。用结构化提问逼你写出复现步骤和最小用例。
why_en: It doesn't teach fixes—it breaks the reflex to patch on sight. Structured prompts force a repro and minimal case until the root.
limit_zh: 只覆盖定位阶段，不提供具体修复代码；需要你能跑通复现步骤；对偶发、环境依赖类 bug 效果有限，它默认问题可稳定复现。
limit_en: Covers diagnosis only, no fix code. Requires a reproducible case; flaky or environment-only bugs may exceed its scope.
title_en: Stop fixing, start locating: 5-step bug triage
